key_insight: FOCUS is a CNS-focused pathology foundation model that improved intraoperative frozen-section diagnosis and biomarker prediction, rather than drug discovery.
clinical_relevance: FOCUS could support more detailed intraoperative CNS tumor assessment, particularly lymphoma detection, while providing provisional molecular information.
method: Pretrained on 27,930 frozen sections enriched for CNS tissue.
Evaluated on diagnostic and biomarker-prediction tasks, including temporal and external cohorts.
Organized ten diagnostic tasks into a WHO-aligned hierarchy and assessed assistance in six neuropathologists.
evidence_signal: FOCUS achieved mean AUCs of 0.969 across 11 internal diagnostic tasks and 0.877 across 12 biomarker-prediction tasks; assistance increased junior readers’ lymphoma sensitivity from 81.6% to 94.7%.
watch_item: Prospective workflow validation is needed to establish real-time reliability and effects on surgical decisions and patient outcomes.
paper_title: FOCUS: A Subspecialty Foundation Model for Intraoperative Central Nervous System Pathology
